title: Make full-viewport labeling and timeline the permanent app layouts
description: Replace regular versus fullscreen branches with one viewport-sized single-page shell. Remove fullscreen entry/exit buttons and redundant page layouts. Keep compact persistent app navigation and bounded content panels, no document-level scrolling; only intended panels scroll. Labeling retains large readable item text, horizontal classifier cards when needed, per-card metrics below labeling controls, confidence visualization, optional explanations, persistent bottom-left status and bottom-right Skip/Submit. Timeline fills available pane with its inspector closable; pinch zoom only, horizontal pan and ordinary vertical scrolling remain distinct; mouse zoom buttons and Fit remain reachable. Responsive desktop/iPad portrait/landscape, safe-area and on-screen keyboard behavior. Acceptance: no clipped actions, unintended page scroll or hidden item content; label draft retained across drawers; timeline zoom/pan/play/click cursor still work. Reuse successful existing fullscreen CSS rather than redesign from scratch.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Removed both labeling and timeline fullscreen controls and the separate native/fallback fullscreen state. Focused labeling CSS is now the normal viewport layout. History is a left Radix dialog drawer; optimizer activity a right dialog drawer, with accessible titles, focus trap, Escape/backdrop/close. Browser verified 1280x720 and tablet 768x1024: no document overflow; Skip/Submit remain within viewport. Existing item restored without provider calls or human labels. Still needs narrower/keyboard checks and full timeline/browser regression acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Narrow/short viewport verification exposed ~24px drawer close targets. Close and shared drawer footer buttons now have explicit 44px minimum targets, wrapping footer actions and safe-area top/bottom padding. Browser measured ~43.994px rounding for Close/Save, both inside a 1025x625 CSS viewport (820x500 browser override at existing zoom), no document scroll. Full-screen narrow menu checked at 487px CSS width with no document overflow and modal focus wrapping. Screenshots var/web/mobile-navigation-focus-proof.jpg and short-viewport-drawer-proof.jpg. No labels or model calls. Physical-iPad keyboard/safe-area and full timeline gesture acceptance remain unverified; issue remains open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Playback acceptance slice: fixed Reset zoom restoring only a four-cycle window. Fit all cycles now restores the complete recorded range after deep zoom. Regression specs failed before the fix; 23 trace specs and all 153 UI tests pass, and UI builds. Live-disabled synthetic workspace browser check confirms zoom buttons, Fit, Next, paired exact decision request/response, and Play advancing the visible pointer through cycle 3. No human votes or paid calls. Physical iPad pinch/scroll and broad workspace acceptance remain open.
